macro.headline: RBA rate hike (May 5) and Macquarie earnings (May 8) dominate a pivotal week for ASX amid $108 oil and $4,600 gold.
themes: RBA Rate Hike: Expected 25bp hike to 4.35% on Tuesday — third consecutive hike in 2026. Banks benefit from wider NIMs, REITs/discretionary under pressure.
Oil at $108/bbl: Strait of Hormuz disruption keeps energy elevated. Energy stocks (WDS, STO) outperforming. Inflationary pressure on consumers.
Gold at $4,600/oz: Geopolitical safe-haven demand supports gold miners (NST, RRL). Correction from Jan $5,595 high creates entry opportunity.
